plan.perWeek_note: [assumed] same as Gousto's 4; change to suit how many COOK nights you want
plan.packs: a Serves 2 pack, else two Serves 1 packs
plan.maxPerProteinType_note: [assumed] the proposed 4 has at most 2 dishes of one protein

catalogue.categories_note: main-meal categories under /menu/main-meals/. Sides, sauces, kids and extras are left out
catalogue.extraSources_note: pages listed by pack size; their meals get a protein type from the categories above, else from the title
catalogue.cuisineCategories_note: tags mains by cuisine so sides are only paired where they fit

sugarsG.note: added sugar should weigh more than intrinsic; the data does not separate them

exclude.proteinTypes_note: [assumed] copied from gousto-picker, which skips vegetarian; remove to include them
exclude.titlePattern_note: kids' meals and wings sit in the protein categories too

hardDrop.note: [user-set] cranberry: partner dislikes it. Applies to mains and sides, by title and ingredients

flagOnly.note: matched in the ingredient list; COOK meals are cooked dishes, so a match is usually structural

processing.note: COOK says it adds no additives, but bought-in parts (ham, stock, pastes) can carry them. Processed meat is flagged for LDL and bowel-cancer guidance

variety.fishBonus_note: [assumed] subtracted from a fish dish's penalty when choosing the final 4. Nutrition decides; fish only wins close calls. 0 ignores fish.

weights.note: [assumed] penalty = each target miss as a fraction of its limit x its weight, plus hotPerChilli x chilli level. Lower ranks higher. Same formula as gousto-picker stage 2 without cook time, which COOK does not publish. Nutrition is for the main only: a side (rice, greens) adds fibre and kcal

sides.minImprovement_note: [assumed] the side must also lower the meal's penalty by at least this much
sides.excludeTitlePattern_note: [assumed] gravies, sauces, Christmas trimmings and meaty starters are not complements
sides.cuisine_note: a side matching a cuisine's terms pairs only with mains of that cuisine (rice is in both); all other sides pair only with mains that are neither indian nor asian
sides.starch_note: a starchy side is not paired with a main that already has a starch in its title
sides.pairing: only to lift a main from outside the top 10 into it; mains already in the top 10 by themselves stay unpaired
